notes.title: PT 0.0.18.0 Update
notes.content:
巡航模式
- 在增加区域（zone）的遭遇复杂度后，从一个遭遇赶往下一个的过程就非常痛苦，尤其是有垂直落差的情况下，更糟糕了。
- 现在增加了一种新的操控模式”巡航“模式
- 巡航模式下，飞船会获得很高的直线速度，但转向能力降低。玩家可以用类似其他战机游戏的鼠标偏移转向的操作来控制飞船。角度虽然有约束，但玩家也同样获得了快速接近不同高度遭遇的能力。
- 巡航模式下，所有武器下线
- 启动巡航模式有个过程，如果前方有障碍，或者周围有敌人，无法启动
环境
- 增加一些残骸环境
- 开始在星系内完善更多的Zone环境，先把整体流程体验的基本形式做出来
- POI和遭遇的配合关系进行一定程度关联
其他
- 完善采矿，采集气体的表现
- 增加了关卡信息展示
- Zone通关条件曾了一种进度积分模式
- Zone内Encounter变多后，只依赖一两个关键遭遇通关，有些时候并不合适。所以对通关条件进行了一些改造
战斗
- 敌人AI增加了小队概念，小队中一个单位开始作战，其他单位也会启动作战状态
- HUD信息显示优化，降低屏幕外不重要信息的密度
Bug
- 打开放大镜头后，远景没有对齐
- 修复有些区域会因为敌人配置问题无法进入
- 解决任何击杀都给玩家发奖励的问题
- 解决武器槽位可能在换船的时候无法正确清理的情况
- 防止因为个别子弹报错，导致整体子弹停止更新
- 修复导弹属性获取时的报错

notes.title: More Combat Optimization
notes.content:
Combat Optimization
Main Cannon Improvements:
- The shooting experience of the main cannon against small targets has been enhanced through several experiments.
- Implemented a core armor-like shooting mechanism for the main cannon, similar to Armor Core 6, where the cannon auto-aims at locked targets.
- This significantly improved effectiveness against small units.
- However, this mode made shooting at battleships less engaging due to their lack of high mobility compared to AC.
- This shooting mode has been moved to technical reserve.
Auxiliary Aiming:
- Added a new sight attachment to assist with aiming, which is particularly helpful for small targets.
- Optimized the soft lock mechanism, limiting its range rather than keeping it always active.
- Conducted tests with long-range weapons for shooting experience.
Shields:
- Enhanced shield hit effects.
- Manual shields now have a spherical display with their own hit detection.
Side Cannons:
- Side lasers now support spread aiming, reducing instances of automatic hits.
- Added chaotic shooting to side cannons when targeting is locked.
Missiles:
- Improved tracking algorithms with predictive tracking for higher hit rates.
- Changed missile firing to single delayed shots instead of full salvo, reducing distractions and improving experience.
Secondary Weapons Expansion:
- Added CIWS (Close-In Weapon System) for close-range defense.
- Introduced pulse laser weapons for long-range output.
- Added standard projectile weapons for long-range attacks.
- Secondary weapons now include chaotic shooting traits.
Tutorials:
- Simple control tutorials are now accessible from the pause menu under the "Tutorial" section.
- Currently covers mobility, attack methods, and survival concepts.
